question: From that autonomy, that autonomous thing abides surging forth in itself; because it shines, therefore even excluded from loss of Śiva-immersion?
premises: it surges forth and abides in itself
because it shines it is excluded from loss of Śiva-immersion
inference: Autonomy causes the thing to shine in itself and remain excluded from loss of Śiva-immersion.
plain_english: From that autonomy, that autonomous thing abides surging forth in itself; because it shines, therefore it is even excluded from loss of Śiva-immersion.
